description: Decision-cited standalone round-trip calibration rows available when D0050 froze breadth. These rows calibrate placement only and are not stage acceptance evidence. Extended through B0236 with separately named exact direct-output approximate-coplanar, direct-LAS radiusassign, direct-LAS outlier/NNDistance, direct-LAS same-radius outlier/radialdensity, neighborclassifier, mapped-source/permutation sort and skewness composition ladders, the label/NNDistance hybrid ladder, the mapped-source/direct-double HAG-NN count-one ladder, and the mapped-source/direct-double HAG-Delaunay count-three ladder. B0280 adds independent exact-machine, clean-upstream complete-process rows for the 35,976,465-point VEIL format-6/LAZ extra-dimensions graph and both normal/covariance publications on the 47,478,228-point format-8 AHN4 tile. The embedded envelope ends at that locally observed ceiling rather than copying the shipped profile's rounded 48M class bound; the other ordinary shared-index stage rows and coefficients remain unchanged.
